topic: Flaky tests, and make cover drops a package whose tests fail
detail: Seen while validating SP-077 on 2026-11-15 under load from parallel lanes: TestRunMeasuresFailedRuns (internal/agentrun) failed 1 in 8 runs on main too ('a timed-out run must still record how long it took'); internal/daemon failed once inside 'make cover' and passed on the rerun. scripts/cover.sh skips a package whose tests fail (go test ... || true), so that run reported 'All files >= 80%' without any internal/daemon file. Proposed: make cover.sh fail when a package's tests fail, and look at the agentrun timing.
